If % is non-null and DIC("S") exists, execute DIC("S"). If condition is true, write % if DB(DQ) doesn't exist, then go to V

6965e2c6: Loop through pieces of DU delimited by ';'. Set Y to each piece, DG to position of ':'_X in Y. If Y is null, go to X. Set YS to Y, set Y to piece before ':'. If DG is true and DIC("S") exists, execute DIC("S"). If condition is true, quit if DG is true
320cb39b: If DB(DQ) doesn't exist, write substring of YS starting at DG. Set X to piece of YS before ':'
626f6256: Check for an existing entry and exit if a problem occurred.

7b93e087: If the field doesn't exist in the DD array, call the O subroutine, then branch to RD if X is not '@', to A if X is '@' and the field value is not a pointer, or execute X if it is '@'. If X is not '@', set Y to X.
6e48ba2d: Set DG to the field value DV, Y to the entry value DE(DQ), and X to the field help DU. If a COMPUTED expression exists for the field, execute it.

c8b3c118: If DG indicates a pointer field and the file pointed to exists, set X to the .01 field of the pointed-to file. If the entry in the pointed-to file exists, set Y to the .01 field and X to the COMPUTED POINTER expression. If DG indicates a VARIABLE POINTER, do the same but get additional properties from the data dictionary.

6bc1cdef: If DG indicates a VARIABLE POINTER, get the .01 field of the pointed-to file as X. If the pointed-to entry exists, set Y to the .01 field. If the COMPUTED POINTER expression exists in the dictionary, get it and the VARIABLE POINTER type into DG and X.
9a777ce8: If DG indicates a DATE VALUED field, execute the associated UTILITY code. If DG indicates a SET VALUED field, get the external value into Y from the set of codes for the field.
